summary: Completed testing of Extended Automation Suite (Iteration 276) - New action types (push_to_ota, post_to_chat), new trigger (rate_override_set), and AI-suggested rules endpoint. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with all required data-testid attributes and Turkish UI working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test automation rules created and cleaned up during testing. Chat channels verified/created for post_to_chat testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Extended Automation Suite fully tested. New features accessible via Quality Assurance > Otomasyon kuralları in sidebar. All data-testid attributes verified.

catalog_expanded: rate_override_set trigger label: 'Owner fiyat override yaptı'
new_action_types: push_to_ota action: queues jobs to channel_sync_queue with adapters and job_type params
post_to_chat action: writes messages to chat_messages with author_name starting with '⚡' and author_id='automation'
Template substitution works for {date}, {new_rate}, {room_type_id} in action params
rule_creation: POST /api/automation/v2/rules accepts push_to_ota and post_to_chat actions
Invalid action types are rejected with 400 error
fire_event: POST /api/automation/v2/fire with event='rate_override_set' triggers matching rules
push_to_ota action creates entries in channel_sync_queue with status='pending' and created_by='automation:{rule_id}'
post_to_chat action creates messages in chat_messages (requires channel to exist)
rates_grid_integration: POST /api/rates/grid/submit-to-pms fires rate_override_set event via asyncio.create_task
Automation runs are created in automation_runs collection when matching rules exist
ai_suggest_endpoint: GET /api/automation/v2/suggest returns suggestions array with valid structure
Each suggestion has name, description, trigger (from TRIGGER_CATALOG), and actions (from ACTION_CATALOG)
Returns stats about 30-day activity (total_bookings_30d, vip_bookings_30d, etc.)
frontend_ui: data-testid='automation-suggest-btn' present with text '✨ AI Önerileri Al'
Create modal shows all 9 triggers including rate_override_set
Create modal shows all 8 actions including push_to_ota and post_to_chat
push_to_ota action shows adapters and job_type input fields
post_to_chat action shows channel and body input fields
Turkish UI labels throughout (Otomasyon Kuralları, Tetikleyici, Aksiyonlar, etc.)

mocked_apis.channel_manager_v2: OTA calls are SIMULATED (80% success / 15% transient / 5% permanent). Real adapter SDKs are hot-swappable when API credentials arrive.
mocked_apis.ai_suggest: Uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY with gpt-4o-mini via emergentintegrations.llm.chat.LlmChat
